reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread under their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm ticket #6980:

- **The channel:** #central-team has nothing about Tamsin Cold Chain or a gate kiosk outage.
- **The file share:** I couldn't see any account or ticket files there, so there was nothing to check the number against.

I told Hollis to keep #6980 marked as unverified until someone confirms it with Tamsin or support. I also offered to record it somewhere or draft a quick internal question to support. I didn't use `search_messages`, so the check only covered what Hollis could see themselves.
